messages:
sara-cust: Hey team, customer reporting unexpected extra token charges after a brief client timeout. dashboard shows 1.2M tokens for the session, invoice shows 1.6M. invoice ID INV-2026-4219. unsure if retries replayed requests. any quick checks?

maya-support: Thanks for the heads up — can you paste repro steps + timestamp range? also any idempotency-key usage from the client?

sara-cust: They're using our JS SDK v0.9.2. Sequence: send request -> client timed out after 6s -> frontend retried once automatically -> server eventually accepted both and returned 200s. Happened across three requests in same session. Time range ~ 2026-03-10T14:22:30Z -> 14:25:10Z. No explicit idempotency key on client.

liam-infra: Can you drop the raw request/response logs (ingress) + any gateway retry logs? looking for duplicate request IDs or different idempotency headers.

sara-cust: Pasting sanitized excerpts below:

```
# client attempts
POST /v1/generate 200ms -> TIMEOUT at client (no idempotency-key)
POST /v1/generate 14:23:01Z -> 200 OK (server processed)

# gateway/ingress excerpt
[14:23:01.056] conn=5345 req_id=abc123 status=502 upstream_err="read timeout"
[14:23:01.058] conn=5345 req_id=abc123 retry=1 forwarded_to=runtime-12
[14:23:03.412] conn=5345 req_id=abc123 status=200 upstream_id=rt-req-789
```

sara-cust: Metering snapshots: dashboard (per-route tokens): 400k, 400k, 400k across three requests = 1.2M. Ledger/invoice line items show 533k, 533k, 533k = ~1.6M. looks like invoiced tokens ~1.33x dashboard tokens.

metering-bot: Automated event: replay_detector.triggered for req_id=abc123 at 2026-03-10T14:23:03Z. Possible replay path: ingress->retry->runtime. Event: {"path":"gateway_retry","policy":"qos-retry"} 

liam-infra: That gateway excerpt shows a 502 then an immediate retry — gateway assigned retry=1 and forwarded to runtime which processed the same logical request again. Because the client didn't present an idempotency-key, runtime treated them as separate billable requests. The 502 likely came from an upstream stall; gateway retry logic didn't suppress billing on retry.

owen-billing: We need to validate invoice vs ledger source. Can you pull raw metering events (kafka topic: metering.events) for req_id=abc123 window 14:22:30-14:25:30 and attach? If confirmed double-billing we can issue a credit and patch billing rules.

maya-support: Quick mitigation: recommend we (1) issue a temporary credit to customer for invoice INV-2026-4219 while investigating, (2) set an endpoint-side guard to ignore gateway-initiated retries when upstream status is 502 and the client gave no idempotency key, and (3) add SDK guidance to set idempotency-key for non-idempotent requests. Thoughts?

liam-infra: Agreed on the mitigation. For (2) we can update gateway so that retries are marked as internal_replay and runtime won't emit metering events for requests where header X-Internal-Retry exists. Need a small runtime change to check this header before emitting metering events. Will open infra PR.

sara-cust: Customer wants a short postmortem + timestamped credits. I'll collect the metering.events and send.

owen-billing: Please include amount estimate in USD and the exact ledger lines. I'll pre-authorize a credit hold so finance can fast-track refund once validated. :thumbsup:

maya-support: For repro we should also try to reproduce with controlled failure: simulate upstream stall so gateway triggers retry and observe metering events. I'll spin up a small test harness and post steps.

liam-infra: Assigning to me to triage infra path. filing issue #INF-2026-512: "gateway-internal-retries-produce-metering-duplicates when no idempotency header". ETA for fix = 2 business days (hotfix).

metering-bot: Note: metering pipeline shows two distinct metering_event IDs for upstream_id=rt-req-789 and upstream_id=rt-req-790 despite same client_req_id=abc123. Correlation missing because client_idempotency header absent.

sara-cust: Thanks all — I'll DM customer about credit in progress and share follow-up when we have the metering dump.

maya-support: Good catch. After hotfix we should add a test to e2e suite to ensure gateway retry header suppresses extra meter. Also update docs/FAQ for "duplicate charges after client timeout" scenario.

owen-billing: Once we have the metering_events I'll reconcile and put the refund through. Keep me posted.

liam-infra: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2876 - adds X-Internal-Retry header and runtime check to skip metering emit. Rolling to staging now.

sara-cust: closing loop: customer accepted provisional credit. will reopen if anything else shows up. thanks everyone :pray:
